scope: Only copied staging workspaces; never edit the independent engine checkout or preservation archive.

entries.diff_summary: Add finite-aware 1e-6 full-output checker and reset statistics before data generation; on mismatch print only index and real/imaginary component so bare-metal failure reaches the sole Check Failed marker.
Keep the exact 16384-element comparison but let main.cpp emit the sole guest outcome marker.
Cross-compile LLVM IR explicitly for armv7-pc-none-eabi like other staged workloads.
entries.unified_diff:
--- benchmarks/sys_validation/stencil3d/hw/Makefile
+++ experiments/regression/overlays/stencil3d/hw/Makefile
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 KERN=stencil3d.c top.c
 build: $(FILES)
-	clang -O1 -S -fno-slp-vectorize -fno-vectorize -fno-unroll-loops -fno-inline -fno-builtin -emit-llvm $(KERN)
+	clang -O1 -S -target armv7-pc-none-eabi -fno-slp-vectorize -fno-vectorize -fno-unroll-loops -fno-inline -fno-builtin -emit-llvm $(KERN)
 
 clean:
 	rm -f *.ll
